newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle Friday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle Friday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers on Friday were not well tested, USDA said.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1275-1300 lbs - pen far West 66.00; load dressed basis 105.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150 lbs - load 66.00.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
Confirmed - 400 Last Week - 1,400 Last Year - 7,900 Wk To Date - None Sm Pd Lst Wk - None Sm Pd Lst Yr - None
